# Fixture League (a test fixture)

A test fixture for the run checker's `data` citations (WU-89), in the entry form M-20's handoff sets for the Markdown
data files: each entry an H3 `### <Name>` whose next line is `- Id: <id>`. Its entries are made up; it is no digest of
any league.

## Head

- Crimson Test Spear (unique spear): a made-up spear the PoB pin doesn't know.
- Test Infusion Gem (skill gem): a made-up gem.
